races.paceDynamic: And She Was will take them along at a sensible pace from the front, with Uncle Remus, Collanisi and Prince Rhinegold likely to track her in the early stages. The lack of other confirmed pace-setters means And She Was can dictate terms without pressure, potentially setting up a steady gallop that builds gradually. With most of the field preferring to be held up including the higher-rated Forever Penywern, Penn Avenue and Berkshire Smudge, the race will develop into a tactical affair where positioning and timing become crucial. This moderate early pace followed by a sprint finish strongly favours the prominent racers who can stay close enough to strike, rather than the hold-up horses who may find themselves with too much to do.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If Uncle Remus, Collanisi or Prince Rhinegold can track And She Was without being too far back
scenarios.body: They avoid the traffic problems that will plague the hold-up brigade and can time their challenges perfectly. The steady early pace suits their style as they won't be caught flat-footed when the race quickens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes even steadier and Forever Penywern or Penn Avenue gets the perfect run from the back
scenarios.body: The class horses can unleash their superior finishing kicks over the final two furlongs. Forever Penywern's recent form and Penn Avenue's consistency make them dangerous if getting clear sailing.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Running Coup
scenarios.trigger: If And She Was can quicken the tempo from halfway and string out the field
scenarios.body: Her opponents will be caught napping by the change of pace and she can build an unassailable lead. The 109-day break could have her primed for a big run at decent odds.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush Special
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a messy scramble and Prince Rhinegold's 8lb weight advantage tells
scenarios.body: The veteran can pick his way through while others struggle with the pace or positioning. His recent form shows he retains ability and the handicapper may have been lenient.

watchPoints.text: Watch how quickly Uncle Remus and Collanisi can get into prominent positions as they hold the tactical advantage
Monitor if Penn Avenue or Forever Penywern can secure racing room turning for home as traffic will be crucial
Keep an eye on And She Was early - if she goes off too fast she'll set it up for the closers behind
Check Prince Rhinegold's market moves as his weight advantage could make him a live outsider
Watch for any market confidence behind Peace Motivator given his lengthy absence could be significant

runners_data.comment: Has stopped quickly in two maiden hurdles, with and without a tongue-tie
runners_data.spotlight: Second in a point and his bumper run wasn't devoid of promise; however, has stopped quickly in two maiden hurdles, with and without a tongue-tie.

runners_data.name: Getaway Vic
runners_data.note: Returning after 390-day break but has excellent record on good going and proven winning form over course and distance

runners_data.name: Kind Intention
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after long layoff with limited recent form to assess fitness levels

runners_data.name: Mariniere
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with concerning trend of fading in finish, particularly vulnerable if pace doesn't collapse

runners_data.name: Yellow Card

races.paceDynamic: Idaho Fire looks the most natural front runner in this six-runner field, with Fairye Forth, Getaway Vic, and the prominent runners likely tracking close behind through the early stages. The modest field size should create a sustainable tempo without excessive early pressure, allowing the pace to build gradually through the race. Kind Intention, Mariniere, and Yellow Card as hold-up horses will need the pace to collapse late or find gaps from off the tempo. This race shape clearly favours the prominent runners who can track Idaho Fire and have tactical speed to respond when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Idaho Fire sets sustainable fractions without getting into a speed duel early
scenarios.body: The front group stays intact longer, allowing Fairye Forth and Getaway Vic to use their class and tactical speed to strike in the final furlong. Hold-up horses find themselves too far back when the real running begins.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Idaho Fire goes too slow early and gets caught napping by prominent trackers
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle, suiting horses with a turn of foot rather than sustained galloping ability. Getaway Vic's fresher legs after a long break could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Idaho Fire finds himself alone on the lead with no pressure through halfway
scenarios.body: He gets an uncontested lead and the chasing pack leaves their move too late to reel him back in. The Paul Nicholls-trained runner finally puts together a complete performance over hurdles.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and the prominent runners tie each other up
scenarios.body: Kind Intention or Mariniere find significant improvement from their hold-up positions to capitalize on a weakening pace. This requires the front group to go faster than the small field suggests.

watchPoints.text: Mariniere's stamina limitations could be exposed if this becomes a true staying test over 2m4f
Idaho Fire's recent tendency to stop quickly - watch for early signs of another fade from the front
Getaway Vic's fitness levels after 390 days off, though trainer Mickey Bowen has decent recent strike rate
Kind Intention needs significant gaps to appear from his hold-up position in this small field
Weather conditions at Ffos Las as good going has been consistent across the card

races.paceDynamic: Parliamo is the only genuine front runner in this field and will be allowed to dictate terms from the front without pressure early. Constantinian and Hillwalk will sit prominently but neither are natural pace-pressers, allowing Parliamo to control fractions through the middle sections. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Times Are Green, Les's Destiny Star, Jaja Jimmy, Dessie Haze, Colby Mayfield, Star Turn) will track behind waiting for their moment. This tactical setup clearly favours the prominent racers who can position close enough to the lone leader without having to mount a sustained challenge from the back of the pack.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Parliamo maintains a steady gallop without being pressured early
scenarios.body: The 7-claimer Mr Darren Andrews gets an armchair ride to the business end where Parliamo's class advantage tells. The hold-up horses find too much to do when the real pace begins.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If Constantinian or Hillwalk move to challenge Parliamo approaching the final flight
scenarios.body: The prominent pair have been ideally placed throughout and kick clear as the backmarkers struggle to close from their disadvantageous positions. Recent winner Constantinian has the form edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian allowing the hold-up brigade to close effectively
scenarios.body: Times Are Green or Les's Destiny Star time their runs perfectly as the leaders tire in the final furlong. The higher-rated hold-up horses benefit from a truly-run finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Parliamo compounds too early leaving a tactical mess
scenarios.body: Multiple horses arrive together in a blanket finish where any of the field could prevail in a sprint. The race becomes a lottery with recent form and jockey skills decisive.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Parliamo being allowed to steal several lengths at the start as he's the only confirmed leader
Monitor how aggressively Constantinian and Hillwalk position themselves as they could dictate whether the pace is genuine
Check if any of the hold-up horses begin tracking closer than usual as this would signal tactical awareness of the pace scenario
Observe Jaja Jimmy's early behavior with the new tongue-tie as headgear changes can be significant after breaks
Watch for Times Are Green getting outpaced early as his hold-up style needs the leaders to go a good gallop

races.paceDynamic: Buckna stands alone as the identified front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a steady gallop without pressure given the lack of other confirmed pace-setters. Hell Hound, Imperial Alex, Copshill Lad, The Boola Boss and Arrycan will track prominently but none are natural pace-forcers, allowing Buckna to control the tempo. The hold-up brigade of Karuma Grey, Galop De Chasse, Fairlawn Flyer and Balkardy face the tactical disadvantage of relying on a finish from off the pace when the front end may not be truly tested. This race shape strongly favours the prominent racers and potentially the lone leader Buckna, as the sustainable pace will suit those positioned handily rather than horses needing a strong gallop to unlock their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Buckna Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Buckna gets an easy lead and sustains his gallop to the line.
scenarios.body: With no pressure on the front end, Buckna can dictate ideal fractions and prove hard to peg back despite carrying top weight. The lack of pace pressure means prominent runners like Hell Hound and Imperial Alex struggle to get past a horse in complete control.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners Hell Hound, Imperial Alex and The Boola Boss apply more pressure than expected.
scenarios.body: A genuine pace battle emerges between multiple prominent runners, creating the strong gallop that favours closers. This allows Karuma Grey and Fairlawn Flyer to unleash their finishing kicks in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final mile allowing closers to dominate.
scenarios.body: The front-runners go too slow early then stop quickly, creating perfect conditions for the back-markers to sweep past. Karuma Grey's class tells despite tactical disadvantage, while Fairlawn Flyer benefits from the strong pace his running style demands.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Buckna doesn't handle the front-running role or fades dramatically.
scenarios.body: The expected leader fails to deliver, creating a muddled pace where any running style can prevail. Copshill Lad and Imperial Alex benefit from the tactical chaos, being versatile enough to adapt when the race doesn't unfold as anticipated.

watchPoints.text: Buckna getting a soft lead through the early stages - if uncontested he becomes extremely difficult to peg back
Hell Hound and Imperial Alex failing to apply any pace pressure - this would play directly into Buckna's hands
Karuma Grey's early positioning - needs to be closer than usual if the pace is steady to have any winning chance
The Boola Boss tracking too far back - his best recent form comes when prominent throughout
Fairlawn Flyer handling the return from 149-day absence over this demanding trip after such a long break

races.paceDynamic: Alba Crus will lead uncontested from the start, setting a sustainable gallop that suits her front-running style perfectly. With no other confirmed pace-setters among the 12 runners, she'll dictate terms throughout the 2m4f trip without early pressure. The prominent runners This Sway, Albert Park, Kylenoe Dancer and Play On Court will track her in the second rank, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Lion Of The Desert, Bells Of Ufford and Mind Hunter will need Alba Crus to provide enough pace to set up their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can position close to the pace early, as the lack of early speed will make it difficult for hold-up horses to produce their best.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Alba Crus Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Alba Crus handles the 110-day break and maintains her front-running dominance.
scenarios.body: She gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home, with the hold-up horses left with too much to do from the back. Her proven ability at this trip on good ground makes her the logical beneficiary of the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can slip Alba Crus and outstay her in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: This Sway or Kylenoe Dancer tracks the leader throughout before taking over late, benefiting from the honest pace without having done the donkey work. The lack of early pace pressure allows them to conserve energy for a decisive move.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Rallies
scenarios.trigger: If Alba Crus sets a stronger pace than expected and comes back to the field late.
scenarios.body: Lion Of The Desert or Bells Of Ufford produce their trademark finishing kicks as the leaders tire, with the extended 2m4f trip playing to their stamina strengths. Their higher ratings suggest they have the class to overcome the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Alba Crus goes too slow early and multiple horses challenge simultaneously in a messy finish.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish with no clear pace advantage, allowing any horse with tactical speed to get involved regardless of running style. This creates the most unpredictable outcome with longer-priced runners coming into play.

watchPoints.text: Alba Crus must handle the 110-day layoff smoothly as any early mistakes could disrupt her front-running tactics
This Sway's jumping under pressure as prominent runners often face challenges when trying to match the leader's pace
Lion Of The Desert needs Alba Crus to set genuine pace early or his hold-up style becomes ineffective
First-time headgear changes on Bells Of Ufford (cheekpieces) and Albert Park (visor) could spark improvement
Mind Hunter receiving 26lbs from top-weight makes him dangerous if the pace sets up right for hold-up horses

races.paceDynamic: L'Empire Vert and Rangatira Jack will contest the early lead, with both natural front-runners unlikely to yield easily. This creates an honest gallop from the start, with Boston Joe and Jack's A Legend tracking prominently behind the leaders. The sustained pace will set up a tactical finish where the hold-up horses can use their stamina reserves in the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up brigade who can conserve energy while the pace angle burns out the leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace between L'Empire Vert and Rangatira Jack proves too strong
scenarios.body: The front-runners weaken approaching the final fence, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past with their superior finishing kick. Loki's Mischief, Lelant, and Jack's Jury are perfectly positioned to capitalize on this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Boston Joe or Jack's A Legend can secure the ideal tracking position behind the dueling leaders
scenarios.body: They get first run on the weakening pace-setters while avoiding the early battle, timing their challenge perfectly at the business end. Boston Joe's recent win and Jack's A Legend's veteran cunning make them prime beneficiaries of this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of L'Empire Vert or Rangatira Jack can steal a march while the other falters early
scenarios.body: The survivor gets an easier lead than anticipated and has enough left to repel the late challengers. L'Empire Vert's superior class rating gives him the edge in this scenario over Rangatira Jack.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners go too fast and the prominent trackers also get involved too early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawl in the middle stages before exploding late, suiting the most patient hold-up horses with tactical speed. Radharc Na Slaine's long absence becomes an advantage with fresh legs for a sustained finish.

watchPoints.text: L'Empire Vert and Rangatira Jack must be monitored early as an overly aggressive pace battle could eliminate both as winning chances
Boston Joe needs to secure the ideal tracking position behind the leaders without getting drawn into their early battle
Radharc Na Slaine requires close observation given his 187-day absence and whether he shows any signs of rustiness early
Jack's A Legend must be watched for how well inexperienced jockey Imogen Mathias handles the veteran in this tactical affair
Loki's Mischief's jumping must be sharp throughout as any mistakes from his hold-up position could prove costly in a competitive finish
